areas.name: Secrets, Cooperative Play, and Shooting Range
areas.location_cue: Hidden environmental interactions, the cooperative mission selector, and the standalone Shooting Range.
areas.note: Only reproducible, source-backed secrets are included; expired community-event counters are not presented as permanent requirements.

levels.1: Inspect the island town's rooftops, ledges, and training props with binoculars.
levels.2: Find and shoot every cardboard pigeon hidden across the island-abbey map.
levels.3: Use the Service Record mission medal as the counter, sweep from the marsh approach through the town and abbey, and destroy each cardboard bird with a shot. Revisit the map until the counter reaches ten; ordinary stone eagles are a separate category.

levels.1: Check gardens, walls, sheds, and construction clutter in the coastal fortification map.
levels.2: Find and shoot every small gnome hidden around the coastal fortifications.
levels.3: Sweep every garden and roadside compound with binoculars, shoot each brightly painted gnome, and use the mission medal counter to verify the full set. Reloading after registration does not remove recorded progress.

levels.1: A tall industrial interior contains a crawlspace that goes far beyond a normal shortcut.
levels.2: In the ruined port's large interior complex, locate the concealed vent route and follow it to the hidden elevator scene.
levels.3: Enter the large industrial building, climb into the high ventilation opening, crawl through the extended duct network, and interact with the concealed elevator-area details at the end. Explore every accessible prop before leaving so the full reference sequence is seen.

levels.1: The formal range rewards looking beyond its obvious central lane.
levels.2: Use the island-abbey practice range and strike all five targets from its firing position.
levels.3: Collect the rifle at the range, stand in the marked shooting position, scan the entire backstop and surrounding masonry, and hit each of the five practice targets. Confirm the Service Record medal appears before moving away.

items.label: Trigger the hidden cash-register score effect

levels.1: Some shop counters react to accurate gunfire during Survival.
levels.2: In a compatible Survival shop, shoot the cash-register mechanism with a rifle or pistol.
levels.3: Load Unwanted Guests or Prime Real Estate, locate a shop counter with a cash register, and shoot the register using a rifle or pistol. Watch the score feedback to confirm the concealed interaction; it is an optional reproducible secret, not a permanent reward.

items.label: Complete every full campaign map cooperatively

levels.1: Share tags, revives, and objective routes rather than splitting without coordination.
levels.2: Finish every full base and downloaded campaign map with a co-op partner.
levels.3: Host or join each installed full map, complete its required objectives, and remain together through extraction and results. Use the co-op statistics and mission tiles to verify every map; the short distant-shot epilogue has no comparable roaming co-op checklist.

items.label: Test every installed weapon and ammunition type

levels.1: The range exposes attachment effects without risking an objective run.
levels.2: Fire every installed rifle, secondary weapon, pistol, and ammunition type in the Shooting Range.
levels.3: Open the range from the main menu, equip each weapon in turn, test standard and special ammunition, then cycle its unlocked sights and suppressors. This verifies entitlements and attachments even though the range does not award a separate permanent medal.
